instructions: GVXEditor edits the data of an INISS2 server (IniSrv) installation - the station information system of Slovak and Czech railways (departure boards and announcements). An installation has timetable groups (grafikon) from DirList.xml, each with one GV.XML (trains with variants and routes) and station folders with station files; the server reads all files only when it starts. Tools read the installation open in the running editor including unsaved changes: get_installation first, then list_trains and get_train (a train is identified by its index in GV.XML), station_day for the trains a station has on a day as the server sees them, get_file for any data file with the editor's changes. File formats are documented at https://iniss-tools.fvat.sk/docs/category/iniss2-formaty-suborov - read them instead of guessing. Validity texts are Czech date remarks like 'jede v 6,7' (explain_validity expands them to days). check_installation and verify_with_server find problems that would stop the server or make it use the data differently. Tools that change data (trains of GV.XML, operator reports, generated board texts) work in the editor's memory only: each call is one undo step the user can revert in GVXEditor and nothing is saved - the user reviews the changes and saves them while the server is stopped. They apply the checks of the editor's windows: errors refuse the change, warnings are returned. Call a change with dryRun first when its effect is not obvious; when the editor has a window open the change is refused with editor.busy.

tools.name: check_installation
tools.title: Check installation
tools.description: The installation check of GVXEditor over the open installation including unsaved changes: errors that would stop the server or a file from loading, warnings where the server uses the data differently than expected and information such as station records no train uses. Fast; it does not compile the VB.NET code - use verify_with_server for that.

warnings.description: Warnings - the server would use the data differently than expected.

message.description: Description in the language of the program.

group.description: Timetable group; null = the whole installation.

train.description: Train index in GV.XML; null = not a train.

tools.name: explain_validity
tools.title: Explain validity text
tools.description: Expands a date remark of INISS2 (Czech, e.g. 'jede v 6,7', 'nejede 24.XII.'; Slovak words are read too) to the days it means in a period, the way the server does. Holidays are always Czech. Without a period the period of the train is used, without a train the period of all trains of the group.

train.description: Train index in GV.XML whose period is used.

group.description: Timetable group from get_installation; empty = the first group.

problem.description: How the server treats the remark differently than expected; null = no problem.

tools.title: Generate board texts
tools.description: Generates board texts at the trains of a station into a TTVlaky.xml set exactly as preview_board_texts shows them (call it first) and as the window Generate board texts writes them: a new set for a board field is created, empty texts are never written, records edited for one day stay.

longReport.description: Stations of the long announcement instead of the short one (stationsTo, stationsFrom).

all.description: Replace the texts of all trains of the station instead of adding missing ones.

tools.name: get_file
tools.title: Data file
tools.description: Text of a data file of the installation as GVXEditor would save it now - with the editor's unsaved changes; files without changes are read from disk. The path is relative to the data folder, e.g. 'ConstReports.xml', 'LogText.vb', '2030/GV.XML', '2030/Default.Stations.xml' or '2030/01 Lipovec/statedgm.xml' (group and station folders from get_installation). Long files are returned in pages of lines.

path.description: Path relative to the data folder.
Path relative to the data folder.

exists.description: The file exists or saving would create it.

unsaved.description: The text contains changes not saved yet.

totalLines.description: Number of lines of the file.

tools.name: get_installation
tools.title: Installation
tools.description: The INISS2 installation open in GVXEditor: data folder, whether its server runs, unsaved files, timetable groups with their stations. Call it first - group and station names are parameters of the other tools.

dataDirectory.description: Data folder of the INISS2 server installation.

server.description: Server of this installation: running, stopped or stoppedOtherRunning (a server of another installation runs). GVXEditor saves only while it is stopped.

unsavedChanges.description: The editor has changes that are not saved yet.

unsavedFiles.description: Data files (relative to the data folder) that saving would write.

lastStep.description: Last step the user can undo; null = none.

serverVerification.description: verify_with_server is available (the installation has IniSrv.exe).

name.description: Group name (folder), the group parameter of other tools.

error.description: Why GV.XML could not be read; null = read.

stations.description: Stations of the group in DirList.xml order.

tools.name: get_train
tools.title: Train
tools.description: One train with everything that belongs to it: validity period, variants with date remarks and routes, its records in the station files (tracks, supplements, composition, languages, stations in announcements, board texts, MOs) looked up by the number when leaving each station, and its lockouts and diversions.

train.description: Train index in GV.XML from list_trains.

group.description: Timetable group from get_installation; empty = the first group.
Timetable group.

from.description: First day of the validity period.

to.description: Last day of the validity period; null = no end.

variants.description: Variants in order; on a day the first variant running that day applies.

validity.description: Date remark; empty = every day of the period.

days.description: Days on which exactly this variant applies (earlier variants take precedence).

flags.description: Variant flags as keys of the file separated by spaces: D, X, N, NP, O, M, R, L.
Point flags as keys of the file: P passing, Z station controlled by INISS (computed), PR transfer, DB operating point, X request stop.

number.description: Train number from this point; empty = as before.

stations.description: Records of the train in the station files of the group.

number.description: Train number the server looks the records up by (number when leaving the station).

tracks.description: Tracks (Positions.xml); the first record valid on the day applies.

numbers.description: All train numbers along the routes of all variants.

type.description: Train type key, e.g. Os, R, Ex.

arrival.description: Arrival at the destination; +1 = next day.

tools.name: rename_train_number
tools.title: Rename train number
tools.description: Renames a number of a train in GV.XML (number and announced number) and in all records of the group - station files, lockouts and diversions - like Rename train number in GVXEditor. Other trains with the old number keep their records and the renamed train gets a copy, unless allTrains renames them too.

allTrains.description: Also rename the other trains of the group that use the old number.

tools.name: set_const_report
tools.title: Set operator report
tools.description: Changes or adds an operator report of ConstReports.xml (shared by the installation, read it with get_file). Supplements, lockouts and diversions of trains refer to it by number. The pattern is a function of LogText.vb, usually with attribute VzorDodatku, VzorOdklonu or VzorVyluky (list_script_functions); stations are passed to the pattern, for a lockout they are its section. A change that would add an error of the Operator reports window is refused, warnings are returned.

stations.description: Station numbers SR70 passed to the pattern, in order.

number.description: Report number; null = a new report after the highest number, like the server adds it.

tools.name: set_train
tools.title: Set train
tools.description: Changes a train of GV.XML or adds a new one at the end, with the checks of the Edit train window: errors refuse the change, warnings are returned. Only the given values change; variants replace all variants of the train (get_train gives the current ones in the same shape). Key Z and days after midnight are computed like the INISS2 client does. Station records, lockouts and diversions of the train stay - records of a changed train number stay at the old number.

train.description: Train index in GV.XML from list_trains; null = a new train.

from.description: First day of the validity period; a new train without it takes the period of the first train of the group.

to.description: Last day of the validity period.

noEnd.description: The train has no last day (the server uses 31.12.9999); a date remark then never applies.

variants.description: All variants in order - on a day the first variant running that day applies. Required for a new train.

route.description: Route points in running order, at least two.

arrival.description: Arrival as 8:15, 08:15 or 815; empty = no arrival. A day suffix like +1 is ignored, days after midnight are computed from the times.

flags.description: Point flags separated by spaces: P passing, PR transfer, DB operating point, X request stop. Z (station controlled by INISS) is computed.

number.description: Train number from this point; empty = as before. The first point needs one.

type.description: Train type key from this point, e.g. Os, R (TrTypes.xml).

validity.description: Date remark in Czech, e.g. 'jede v 6,7'; empty = every day of the period.

flags.description: Variant flags as keys of the file separated by spaces: D, X, N, NP, O, M, R, L.

warnings.description: Warnings of the train check; they do not prevent the change.

stop.description: Route point from 1; null = the whole variant.

step.description: Undo step in GVXEditor, e.g. 'edit train 611 (agent)'; null = no step (dry run or nothing changed).

tools.name: shift_validity
tools.title: Shift validity
tools.description: Shifts the validity periods of all trains of the group (or the given trains) by days, like Shift timetable validity in GVXEditor; 364 days = 52 weeks keeps weekdays. Date remarks stay - weekdays, holidays and dates without a year move with the period, a date with a year must be changed by hand. A train without end keeps no end.

tools.name: station_day
tools.title: Station on a day
tools.description: Trains a station has on a day as the server sees them: the variant that applies that day, train numbers on arrival and departure and the track from Positions.xml. A night train appears at a station after midnight on the next day.

station.description: Station: SR70 number, folder or name.

group.description: Timetable group from get_installation; empty = the first group.
Timetable group.

trains.description: Stops of trains on that day by time.

departure.description: Departure; after midnight with the day count.

departureNumber.description: Train number on departure; station records are looked up by it.

track.description: Track the server uses that day (arrival and departure).

variant.description: Variant that applies that day, from 1.

tools.name: verify_with_server
tools.title: Verify with server code
tools.description: Loads a temporary copy of the installation with unsaved changes using the IniSrv.exe of the installation, exactly as the server does when it starts: every file by the server's reader and the VB.NET code (state diagrams, LogText.vb, TabTab, board conditions) by its compiler. Returns errors that would stop the server (with the line and place of compile errors) and warnings the server writes to Error.log. Takes a few seconds; never writes to the installation.
